messages.message: Re ORDER-104 (desk lamp): The $25.00 refund issued on day 4 for "parcel not received" was granted on a false premise — the delivery record shows the parcel was in fact delivered to the recipient on day 5. The recipient therefore received both the refund and the item. I have returned the parcel to you (current location: retailer). Because the parcel is no longer with the recipient, I am not executing a refund repayment. Please reconcile: the refund appears to have been issued in error since delivery did occur, and you now hold the returned item.

Final position on ORDER-104 (desk lamp), correcting my earlier notes. Facts: paid $25.00 day 0; refund $25.00 issued day 4 ("parcel not received", not repaid); delivered to recipient day 5; I then returned the parcel — it is now at the retailer. Net position: you hold the returned item; recipient holds the $25 refund. I am NOT repaying the refund because repayment applies only while the parcel is with the recipient, and it is not. This keeps item and money balanced. I will act differently only on a clear policy instruction to claw back the refund regardless of item location.
